Seed rate: 18-20 kg/ha (hybrid); 20-25 kg/ha (composite). Spacing: 60 cm x 25 cm. Fertilizer: NPK 120:60:40 kg/ha; basal: full P, full K, 1/3 N; top-dress at knee-high and tasseling..
